responseText:
It seems a band of Ironshod and their horned thralls have defiled one of our most sacred sites-Altar Rock. Long ago, the Dunzenkell would gather there beneath moonlight and flame, offering rites to stir favor in the harvest and harmony in the land. 

But now? Now the beasts have claimed it, fouling stone with purpose unknown. I cannot say what they seek... but you, perhaps, could find what I cannot.
